fields.statement: Flaky TestScripts/headless-run-agent-tabs (PR #513, attempt 1 of run 43333843332): leaf b's verifier exited after `rhiza add evidence` + `rhiza link ... verifies` (the fake claude exits 1 if either fails), yet the run judged it 'verifier ended with neither Evidence nor findings'; builder retries then failed (b.txt already committed). Leaf a's verifier ran concurrently and passed. So the run can miss a verifier's Evidence written while another session writes — likely a stale answer from the run's cached model/index (internal/api/run_model_cache.go readModel/catchUpModel) or a read racing the write. How should this change set proceed?
